verdict.rationale: The subscription comparison lists AI-powered note taking ('yapay zeka destekli not alma') as a higher-tier business feature, and automatic call recording appears in a premium tier. Both are only single-line mentions, and nothing describes call summaries or full call transcripts attached to the conversation thread. Voicemail transcription is a related feature and does not count toward live-call summaries. Missing for 10: documentation that call transcripts are generated, documentation of AI summaries attached to the call or conversation history, detail on how notes are surfaced or stored, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI call notes.
